reviewInputs.answer: Test selective HK2 ASO with OXPHOS/FAO inhibition in HK1-negative MM and compare HK1-positive and species-matched models.
Human MM lines, engineered murine P3 HK1 knockout cells, PBMC/BMSC contexts and NSG mice; reused expression datasets, no treated humans.

Metabolic viability proxies, replicate/unit uncertainty, selection, unknown masking/power, high exposures, incomplete target exposure and limited host toxicity measures.
